0022600211.text: The Knicks, at home for their 10th game of the season, are 5-4 and riding a three-game winning streak, sitting 3rd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East with a 3-2 home record. The Bucks are 1-8 and on a five-game losing streak, 5th in the Central and 15th in the East, and they are winless on the road at 0-4. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks took the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026, while Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle issue and a game-time decision for New York and Gary Trent Jr. is out with illness for Milwaukee.
